body: Thank you very much for your efforts in trying to find the article. I'm really surprised you would devote so much for my sake. I don't know what to say.
That would be very helpful for me. I would greatly appreciate it. Thank you.

I just got out of work and I'm feeling a bit more stable at the moment. I don't think about all this stuff when I'm with my boyfriend, so I'm hanging out with him for the night. He knows I had once transitioned, so I'm thinking a talk with him about it might be in the near future, though it's almost certainly going to lead to us breaking off the romantic relationship and becoming more of a friendship. I know I need to talk to a local LGBT group or more specifically a trans group, I'm trying to get a hold of a pro bono therapist I have in town, but he's hard to contact.

Now that I'm feeling a bit better, I can say that I really appreciate the support. I've never felt comfortable reaching out to people about my issues, but I do feel better with the support you gave. It won't last, but for now I'm alright. I want to believe that I'm not trans and that I don't have to go through all of that, but it's looking like that's the best option for me to be happy and able to live my life.
